title: Spreadsheet Survivors
description:
The spreadsheet is fighting backSpreadsheet Survivor is a fast, funny bullet-hell roguelite that runs inside a pixel-perfect fake spreadsheet. You are a single cell. Drop formula-turrets, vacuum up cash, level into absurd builds, and outlast a 20-minute workday.

Four workbooks• Balance Sheet 

• Co-Authored Cloud Sheet 

• Legacy Document (2003) 

• Unlicensed Product Activation

 

The full office suiteInLook  ~ Every achievement, every death, every milestone generates a bespoke email from someone at the company.
 

LinkedOut ~ The professional network in Windows 95 beige. 
 

BullSheet ~ A trading terminal for companies, including a yogurt startup with no business being public.

 

The Boss KeyHit ~ at any moment. The game vanishes behind a mundane and flawless fake workbook. 

No spreadsheets were balanced in the making of this game. Side effects may include looking extremely busy, flinching at the word "audit," and an inexplicable urge to press the tilde key in real meetings.
description_short: A bullet-heaven roguelite disguised as a boring spreadsheet. Mow down waves of errors and survive the 20-minute fiscal year.
